name: Tabletop Infrastructure VR Viewer
summary:
Tabletop Infrastructure VR Viewer is a powerful and intuitive virtual reality application that allows engineers, planners, and stakeholders to explore, review, and collaborate on 3D infrastructure designs. Built to complement the Tabletop Infrastructure Designer, this VR viewer brings digital infrastructure models to life in a highly interactive, spatial environment—enabling teams to engage with their projects like never before.
